quote: A vehicle must not be driven to the left side of the highway at any time: When approaching the crest of a grade or upon a curve in the highway where the driver’s view is obstructed within such distance as to create a hazard in the event another vehicle might approach from the opposite direction. Subsection 2 does not apply upon a one-way highway.

activation.condition: Vehicle approaches a crest of grade or curve on a highway and driver view is obstructed within a hazard-creating distance.

obligation.description: Vehicle must not be driven to the left side of the highway during the stated condition.

exceptions.source_clause: Subsection 2 does not apply upon a one-way highway.
